maria: Quick RFC follow-up: propose a 'precision-proxy' alias layer so customers pick stable names (high/balanced/econ) and we map internally to fp8/int8/4bit + fallbacks. intent: reduce UI complexity while keeping runtime freedom.

jin: good call. how do we handle long ctx and OOM? rules must accept seq_len, model_type.

maria: mapping is rule-based with explicit priority and fallbacks. example: if seq_len>4096 -> int8; else fp8-hybrid; on_oom -> int4-safe; on_quality_drop -> baseline-fp16.

sasha: require shadow-eval per alias before GA. deg_score semantics: sliding-window agreement vs baseline; use hysteresis (2 windows) to avoid ping-pong.

priya: billing concern: if runtime mixes variants per-request, invoices must be stable. proposal: invoice_bucket = max_variant_cost(used_variants) and runtime emits per-token variant telemetry for internal chargebacks.

billing-bot: ticket billing/quant-canonicalize-901 created.

ops-bot: canary start alias=balanced pct=10 at 1801234590.

jin: also add lint preventing overlapping rules without explicit priority and a debug endpoint that returns which mapping fired for a sample payload.

maria: action items: 1) i'll open RFC addendum w/schema + sample YAML 2) sasha wires shadow-eval 3) priya owns billing normalization 4) jin adds lint + debug endpoint. will canary and post metrics here.

ops-bot: canary progress=40% at 1801234610.

sasha: smoke checks: top-1 agreement (100 anchors), token-latency histogram, token-cost delta. keep fast.

maria: opt-in initially; legacy detailed profiles remain behind legacy_precision. will update when PR is up. :rocket:
